name: Order of Battle: World War II

achievements.name: Hero of the Rising Sun
achievements.description: Complete the Japanese campaign.

achievements.name: Pax Americana
achievements.description: Complete the US campaign.

achievements.name: Graduated for War
achievements.description: Complete the tutorial campaign.

achievements.name: Summa Cum Laude
achievements.description: Complete the tutorial campaign without losing any unit. Difficulty level III or higher.

achievements.name: Taken by Force
achievements.description: Capture a Victory Point with an advance move.

achievements.name: Imperial Trinity
achievements.description: Accumulate 3 Yamato class battleships during a campaign game, each with at least 2 kills. Difficulty level III or higher.

achievements.name: Tank Specialist
achievements.description: Accumulate 8 tank class units during a campaign game, each with at least 2 kills. Difficulty level III or higher.

achievements.name: Semper Fi
achievements.description: Accumulate 5 US Marines during a campaign game, each with at least 2 kills. Difficulty level III or higher.

achievements.name: Hoarder
achievements.description: Accumulate a reserve of 1000 Resource Points in a campaign game.

achievements.name: Tank Buster Bronze
achievements.description: Destroy 5 tanks with a single unit in a campaign game.

achievements.name: Tank Buster Silver
achievements.description: Destroy 10 tanks with a single unit in a campaign game.

achievements.name: Tank Buster Gold
achievements.description: Destroy 15 tanks with a single unit in a campaign game.

achievements.name: Grim Reaper Bronze
achievements.description: Destroy 5 infantry units with a single unit in a campaign game.

achievements.name: Grim Reaper Silver
achievements.description: Destroy 10 infantry units with a single unit in a campaign game.

achievements.name: Grim Reaper Gold
achievements.description: Destroy 15 infantry units with a single unit in a campaign game.

achievements.name: Air Ace Bronze
achievements.description: Destroy 5 aircraft with a single unit in a campaign game.

achievements.name: Air Ace Silver
achievements.description: Destroy 10 aircraft with a single unit in a campaign game.

achievements.name: Air Ace Gold
achievements.description: Destroy 15 aircraft with a single unit in a campaign game.

achievements.name: Naval Legend Bronze
achievements.description: Destroy 5 ships with a single unit in a campaign game.

achievements.name: Naval Legend Silver
achievements.description: Destroy 10 ships with a single unit in a campaign game.

achievements.name: Naval Legend Gold
achievements.description: Destroy 15 ships with a single unit in a campaign game.
